_comment: KIT KNOWLEDGE, not your choices: which routes, strings and content belong to each kit feature that src/config/site.json can switch off (`features: { "news": false }`). Read by the app through src/config/site-rules.mts (the feature guard, navigation, home page, header) and by the build scripts through scripts/lib/site-config.mjs (prerender list, sitemap, check-a11y). scripts/check-site-config.mjs holds this file against app.routes.ts and the prerender and sitemap tables. Edit it only when you add or remove a kit feature.
_shellPages: Pages that are no feature and are always on. Articles (articles/*, article/*) and the not-found page are always on too: they are the site's content and frame, not a feature.
_devOnly: Strings only the dev workshop reads (src/app/dev/, stripped from production builds). The key-source language carries them; any other language may leave them out and then shows the workshop in the key-source language (scripts/lib/feature-scope.mjs).
_features: Per feature id: `routes` — route paths it owns (its pages and their legacy redirects; a path also owns everything below it, `learn` owns `learn/x`). `navGroups` — route groups (`group` in app.routes.ts) it owns, so a new page in that group belongs to it without an entry here. `i18n` — namespaces or key paths it owns (a key path owns everything below it); `i18nShared` — key paths below those that other parts of the site read, so they stay required (scripts/check-i18n-keys.mjs fails when code outside the feature reads a key of a namespace the feature owns and the key is not listed here; a key path in a shared namespace, like `app.nav.glossary`, says its readers show it only while the feature is on). `code` — the source files and folders (ending in /) only this feature uses; their reads of its strings need no `i18nShared`. With a feature off, a new language needs none of its strings and none of its collections. `collections` — its content under src/assets/data. `prerenderTier` — 0 (every SEO language), 1 (language tiers 1 and 2) or null, as in scripts/generate-prerender-routes.js. `sitemap` — whether its pages are in scripts/generate-sitemap.js. `a11yPages` — the page keys of scripts/check-a11y.mjs it owns.
